name: Browser Game Maker
tagline: Makes a playable game or toy that runs from a single HTML file.
delivers: One self-contained index.html: no libraries, no build step
A gameplay preview video and poster
A short guide to the controls and how to change it
tools: Chrome or Chromium, run headless for the play-test, scoring screenshots and preview video

brief.label: What should it be?
brief.example: A falling-sand sandbox with water, fire, plants and lava

brief.label: How should it look and feel?
brief.example: Crisp pixels, smooth at 60fps, a nice demo scene on first open

limits: Single-file browser games and toys. No servers, accounts or multiplayer.
checks: Play-tests controls and mechanics in a browser.
Checks for console errors and records a gameplay preview.
Reviews screenshots against the visual bar.
refuses: Does not add a server or multiplayer.
Does not deliver a game requiring a build step.
